summary: Wire tenant-bound Telemetry service authentication (Authorization: Bearer <PANTHEON_TELEMETRY_SERVICE_TOKEN> and X-Tenant-Id) into Evolution's GET /api/telemetry/runtime-summaries and POST /api/telemetry/ingest transport and docker-compose service definitions, with fail-closed validation and strict Telemetry HTTP authority boundary regression coverage.

inspected_receipts.observed_blocker: GET /api/evolution/input-coverage returned 503 with detail 'telemetry runtime summaries are unavailable; coverage is unknown: HTTP Error 401: UNAUTHORIZED' while GET /api/evolution/proposals?limit=100, /api/evolution/sweep-status, and /api/evolution/dispatch-outbox?tenant_id=tenant-dev returned 200.

telemetry runs with telemetry_auth_mode='strict', telemetry_service_token_present=true, and telemetry_service_tenants='tenant-dev', while evolution and evolution-threshold-sweep-producer have telemetry_service_token_present=false and evolution-threshold-sweep-producer has tenant_id=null and evolution_default_tenant_id=null (both at actual_source_blob abf71eea5c350f51ff7ca075fa88a557db71c5bf). Note: checks.reconciliation_uses_same_existing_credential=false reflects zero selected service under that exact label rather than a credential mismatch.

acceptance_verification.ac1_evolution_telemetry_transport_auth_a: passed: default_fetch_summaries and default_admit_telemetry_event build headers via _telemetry_headers, sending Authorization: Bearer <PANTHEON_TELEMETRY_SERVICE_TOKEN> and X-Tenant-Id: <tenant_id>. GET /api/evolution/input-coverage forwards the authenticated request tenant explicitly without falling back to the process default; scheduled producer resolves EVOCHAIN_THRESHOLD_SWEEP_TENANT_ID -> PANTHEON_TENANT_ID -> EVOLUTION_DEFAULT_TENANT_ID. Missing or blank token or tenant fails closed locally with ValueError before any HTTP call; Telemetry 401/403/5xx responses fail closed as 503 on input-coverage and as non-admitted diagnostic errors in run_tick.
acceptance_verification.ac2_compose_wiring: passed: docker-compose.yml wires PANTHEON_TELEMETRY_SERVICE_TOKEN and PANTHEON_TENANT_ID into both evolution and evolution-threshold-sweep-producer (plus EVOLUTION_DEFAULT_TENANT_ID on the producer), matching telemetry's PANTHEON_TELEMETRY_SERVICE_TOKEN contract and keeping EVOLUTION_AUTH_TOKEN separate from Telemetry outbound credentials and Incidents outbound requests.
acceptance_verification.ac3_regression_tests_against_strict_tele: passed: added compose contract assertions in services/evolution/test_compose_activation.py, strict Telemetry HTTP server regressions for default_fetch_summaries / default_admit_telemetry_event / run_tick in services/evolution/test_threshold_sweep_worker.py, and strict Telemetry HTTP server regressions for GET /api/evolution/input-coverage in services/evolution/test_evolution_service.py.
acceptance_verification.ac4_evidence_and_source_only_discipline: passed: no VM, SSH, live runtime, or provider calls were executed; no real secret values are recorded; exact base-fail vs head-pass regression commands/exits and full focused suite retention results are recorded below without claiming hosted L11, Journal, loops, or provider certification.
